title: Audit pipeline retention simulator and tenant-aware cost throttler
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Our audit ingest pipeline is increasingly expensive due to high-cardinality events from large tenants and noisy integrations. Current retention and indexing policies are static and cause unpredictable monthly spend for both hosted and dedicated customers. Goal: Deliver a simulator + runtime throttler that lets us model retention/indexing outcomes across tenant workloads and enforce tenant budgets with graceful degradation. This ticket covers the simulator, schema for tenant budget rules, a runtime cost-throttler module that enforces soft/hard priorities and adaptive sampling, and short-term storage compaction knobs for index granularity. Non-goals: full multi-cluster rebalancer, long-term cold-archive migration (follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can ingest historical event samples and project monthly storage and query-cost under configurable retention/indexing scenarios
Operator UI exposes per-tenant budget rules and shows projected vs actual cost (dashboard link available)
Runtime cost-throttler enforces per-tenant soft budget by applying adaptive sampling and low-priority drop rules under sustained overage
Hard-budget enforcement will block non-privileged ingest when explicit budget exceeded and emit clear audit events
End-to-end tests validate that high-cardinality tenants see reduced index volume but preserved critical event types (auth/admin/role-change) when throttled
Benchmark: throttler adds <5ms median latency to ingest path under load and scales to 10k events/sec without backpressure collapse
design_notes: We will simulate two layers: storage cost (index size, number of shards) and query cost (hot shard query cost projected from access patterns).
Tenant budget rules support (1) token-cost budget (estimated cost per event), (2) index-granularity preference (hourly/daily/compact), and (3) retention tiers (hot:30d, warm:90d, cold:365d).
Adaptive sampling algorithm: maintain per-tenant reservoir of event types with priority weights; when over budget, increase sample rate on low-value types while keeping 100% for admin/auth events.
Priority model: 'critical' (admin/auth/privchange), 'high' (error/ops), 'normal' (user-actions), 'low' (debug/heartbeat). Sampling rules will be configurable per-tenant.
Storage compaction plan: implement nightly compactification job that collapses low-priority events into compact indices (key fields only) to preserve auditability while shrinking storage footprint.
Fallback behavior: when sampler cannot keep up, write events to an overflow cold store and emit an audit event with the sampling decision and reason.
Security: sampling decisions and budget rule changes must be logged to audit with RBAC-v2 enforced on who can change budget rules (admin-only by default).
Compatibility: runtime throttler is implemented as a middleware in the ingest service so Dedicated and Private deployments can enable/disable it by config.
Simulator authenticity: use real anonymized event histograms from prod sampling window to make projections more accurate; synthetic scenarios for spike testing.
We avoid encrypting sampling keys at rest in this phase; sensitive fields still obey PII masking and existing KMS policies.
implementation_plan: 1) Build simulator service that consumes sample logs from S3/GCS and outputs cost projections (storage & query) for policy permutations
2) Define tenant budget rule schema and a minimal CRUD API (validate via RBAC-v2 policy templates)
3) Implement ingest middleware that consults per-tenant budget state and applies sampling/throttling decisions
4) Nightly compactification job to collapse low-value events and update index metadata
5) Instrument counters/metrics and wire to Grafana dashboard for projected vs actual cost
6) Add E2E tests and performance benchmarks; create migration plan for existing tenants to opt-in
7) Release behind feature flag; rollout to canary tenants for 2 weeks then broader opt-in
test_plan: Unit tests for sampling decision logic with deterministic RNG seeds
Integration test: simulator -> config -> throttler -> compactifier producing expected index sizes
Load test: 10k events/sec with mixed tenant sizes and validate <5ms median added latency
Chaos test: abrupt 3x traffic spike ensuring soft-priority throttling gracefully reduces low-priority events
Security test: RBAC-v2 enforcement on budget-rule APIs; ensure only admin role can escalate hard budgets
Data integrity test: critical events retained 100% across sample/throttle windows
metrics: Projected monthly storage savings (GB) per tenant
Actual index size delta before/after compactification
Ingest latency p50/p95 impact from throttler
Number of hard-budget blocks and corresponding customer notifications
